originalLifecycle.OnEnable: Init + subscribe EditorUpdate; old editor timestamp persisted.
originalLifecycle.Init: Clamps grid, binds Graphic.material/materialForRendering or Renderer.sharedMaterial/material, sets flag15 and only first currentST. Does not reset _lastIndex, initialize nextST or zero blend.
originalLifecycle.Update: Manual normalized frame or elapsed-time frames, writes only when _lastIndex changes; nextIndex had no end wrap; no null guard/binding refresh.
originalLifecycle.OnDisable: Called Init again: reread possibly replaced material and reset its ST, then clear helper bit on that new material, leaving previous acquired material flagged.
originalLifecycle.GetModifiedMaterial: Uses static usedMaterialList: first base reuse, subsequent duplicate clones. Same-caller repeated requests can clone; no explicit clone destruction. Not changed by this Mesh slice.
originalLifecycle.multipleRenderer: EditMode sharedMaterial is one global ST/flag target; cannot represent independent frames. Distinct material targets can be independent.
originalLifecycle.destroy: OnDisable does cleanup on normal enabled Component destruction. No original ST snapshot/restore contract; first-frame reset was an Init side effect.

previewLifecycle.Init: Reset frameIndex/lastIndex/next/blend, material first/nextST and intensity. Single frame next0.
previewLifecycle.RendererBinding: Capture existing flag material; Update detects changed/removed Renderer.sharedMaterial and reuses Init, releases old helper bit.
previewLifecycle.RendererDisable: Release only captured old binding; no material reacquisition and no ST reset. Disabled manual Init does not reacquire Renderer helper flag.
previewLifecycle.Graphics: Old Graphic material resolution/OnDisable and GetModifiedMaterial path kept. Common Init nextST/reset fix applies, but full UI clone/lifecycle regression not verified.
previewLifecycle.EditorTime: OnEnable resets private delta/time bookkeeping. Automatic elapsed-time behavior still pending actual test.
previewLifecycle.wrap: Next index wraps modulo frameCount. Manual negative/multi-loop positions and single/invalid grid cases specified.
